description: React component for managing user team memberships in Mattermost admin console, including displaying user info, team list, and handling team membership modifications.

classes.name: ManageTeamsModal
classes.description: React functional component for managing user team memberships, including displaying user info, team list, and actions to remove or modify team memberships.

methods.name: loadTeamsAndTeamMembers
methods.description: Loads team and team member data for a specific user.

methods.name: getTeamMembers
methods.description: Fetches team members for a user.

methods.name: handleRemoveUserFromTeam
methods.description: Removes a user from a specified team.

methods.name: handleMemberRemove
methods.description: Updates state after a user is removed from a team.

methods.name: renderContents
methods.description: Renders the modal content including user info and team list.
